record.paper_title: Steinberg Groups for Jordan Pairs - An Introduction with Open Problems
record.original_question: Let I be an ideal of a Jordan pair V, let can: V -> V/I be the canonical quotient map, and let PE(can): PE(V) -> PE(V/I) be the induced surjective homomorphism on projective elementary groups. Define the relative projective elementary group PE(V, I) to be the kernel of PE(can). Describe PE(V, I) by explicit generators and defining relations.

evidence.quote: the canonical map can : V → V /I induces a surjective group homomorphism PE(can) : PE(V ) → PE(V /I).
Problem: describe PE(V, I) by generators and relations.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V = (V^+, V^-)$ be a Jordan pair, and let $I = (I^+, I^-)$ be an ideal of $V$ (so that $V/I = (V^+/I^+, V^-/I^-)$ is again a Jordan pair). The projective elementary group $\mathrm{PE}(V)$ of $V$ is the subgroup of the automorphism group of $V$ generated by the inner automorphisms $\beta(x,y)$ associated with quasi-invertible pairs $(x,y) \in V^+ \times V^-$ (equivalently, generated by the elementary automorphisms $\exp_+(x)$, $x \in V^+$, and $\exp_-(y)$, $y \in V^-$, when these are defined).

The canonical projection $\mathrm{can}\colon V \to V/I$ induces a surjective group homomorphism
$$\mathrm{PE}(\mathrm{can})\colon \mathrm{PE}(V) \longrightarrow \mathrm{PE}(V/I).$$
Define the relative projective elementary group as
$$\mathrm{PE}(V, I) := \ker\bigl(\mathrm{PE}(\mathrm{can})\bigr).$$

Problem. Give an explicit presentation of $\mathrm{PE}(V, I)$ by generators and defining relations expressed in terms of the data $(V, I)$.
artifact.status_search_result: A presentation of the relative projective elementary group of a Jordan pair by explicit generators and relations is posed as an open problem in the Loos–Neher framework for Steinberg groups of Jordan pairs. Available literature (Loos–Neher, C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris 2010, and subsequent work) describes PE(V) and the Steinberg group St(V) by generators/relations using root-graded commutator relations, but no published explicit presentation of the kernel PE(V,I) was located.

status_evidence.title: Steinberg groups for Jordan pairs (Loos–Neher)
status_evidence.snippet: Describes PE(V) and the Steinberg group St(V) of a Jordan pair via Phi-commutator relations.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational paper on PE(V) and St(V) with generators/relations, but the relative version PE(V,I) is not given an explicit presentation.

status_evidence.title: Steinberg groups for Jordan pairs (Numdam version)
status_evidence.snippet: PE(V) is defined and analyzed for Jordan pairs graded by 3-graded root systems.
status_evidence.claim: The available references treat the absolute case; the relative presentation problem has not been resolved in the literature located.
